campaign.title: Change IS_PASSING threshold from 40 to 45. Preserve CLAMP_SCORE and SCORE_CLASS structurally, including their semantic call bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CLAMP_SCORE(X)
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    CLAMP_SCORE = 0
  ELSE
    CLAMP_SCORE = X
  END IF
  IF (X > 50) THEN
    CLAMP_SCORE = 50
  END IF
  CLAMP_SCORE = CLAMP_SCORE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) >= 40) THEN
    IS_PASSING = 1
  ELSE
    IS_PASSING = 0
  END IF
  IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION SCORE_CLASS(X)
  SCORE_CLASS = 0
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) >= 20) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 1
  END IF
  IF (IS_PASSING(X) >= 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 2
  END IF
  SCORE_CLASS = SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
